44492-whip-and-spur.title: Whip And Spur
44492-whip-and-spur.creator: Unknown
44492-whip-and-spur.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Those who rode over the new Park lands usually rode anything but good saddle-horses. Fast trotters, stout ponies, tolerable carriage-horses, capital cart-horses, there were in plenty. But the clean-cut, thin-crested, bright-eyed, fine-eared, steel-limbed saddle-horse, the saddle-horse _par excellence_,--may I say the only saddle-horse?--rarely came under observation; and when, by exception, such a one did appear, he was usually so ridden that his light was sadly dimmed. It was hard to recognize an elastic step under such an unelastic seat.

arxiv-2011-09985.title: Taylor approximation for chance constrained optimization problems governed by partial differential equations with high-dimensional random parameters Thanks: This research was partially funded by the National Science Foundation, Division of Mathematical Sciences under award DMS-2012453; the Departmen
arxiv-2011-09985.creator: Peng Chen, Omar Ghattas
arxiv-2011-09985.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Peng Chen, Omar Ghattas. We propose a fast and scalable optimization method to solve chance or probabilistic constrained optimization problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-dimensional random parameters. To address the critical computational challenges of expensive PDE solution and high-dimensional uncertainty, we construct surrogates of the constraint function by Taylor approximation, which relies on efficient computation of the derivatives, low rank approximation of the Hessian, and a randomized algorithm for eigenvalue decomposition.

arxiv-2101-11050.title: Non-tautological Hurwitz cycles
arxiv-2101-11050.creator: Carl Lian
arxiv-2101-11050.description: Abstract . We show that various loci of stable curves of sufficiently large genus admitting degree d d covers of positive genus curves define non-tautological algebraic cycles on ℳ ¯ g , N \overline{\mathcal{M}}_{g,N} , assuming the non-vanishing of the d d -th Fourier coefficient of a certain modular form.

arxiv-2105-01217.title: Low-energy probes of small CMB amplitude in models of radiative Higgs mechanism
arxiv-2105-01217.creator: Kiyoharu Kawana
arxiv-2105-01217.description: Abstract The small CMB amplitude A s ≃ 10 − 9 A_{s}\simeq 10^{-9} (or, small temperature fluctuation δ ​ T / T ≃ 10 − 5 \delta T/T\simeq 10^{-5} ) typically requires an unnaturally small effective coupling of an inflaton λ ϕ ∼ 10 − 14 \lambda_{\phi}\sim 10^{-14} .

arxiv-2112-13207.title: FMViz: Visualizing Tests Generated by AFL at the Byte-level
arxiv-2112-13207.creator: Aftab Hussain, Mohammad Amin Alipour
arxiv-2112-13207.description: Abstract Software fuzzing is a strong testing technique that has become the de facto approach for automated software testing and software vulnerability detection in the industry. The random nature of fuzzing makes monitoring and understanding the behavior of fuzzers difficult.

arxiv-2202-01749.title: Implications of an extended dark energy model with massive neutrinos
arxiv-2202-01749.creator: Ravi Kumar Sharma, Kanhaiya Lal Pandey, Subinoy Das
arxiv-2202-01749.description: Abstract Recently there has been reports of finding a lower bound on the neutrino mass parameter ( Σ ​ m ν \Sigma m_{\nu} ) when using ACT and SPTpol data however these bounds on the Σ ​ m ν \Sigma m_{\nu} are still weaker for most case around at 1 σ \sigma level.

arxiv-2207-08084.title: Planetary systems with forces other than gravitational forces
arxiv-2207-08084.creator: Søren Toxvaerd
arxiv-2207-08084.description: Abstract A discrete and exact algorithm for obtaining planetary systems is derived in a recent article (Eur. Phys. J. Plus 2022, 137:99). Here the algorithm is used to obtain planetary systems with forces different from the Newtonian inverse square gravitational forces.

arxiv-2503-20812.title: Entropy Production and Thermodynamic Dynamics in Active and Passive Brownian Systems Driven by Time-Dependent Forces and Temperatures
arxiv-2503-20812.creator: Mesfin Asfaw Taye
arxiv-2503-20812.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mesfin Asfaw Taye. In this work, we examine the impact of time-varying temperature and force on the thermodynamic features of active Brownian motor that moves with velocity v 0 v_{0} against the force as well as passive Brownian motor. By deriving analytical expressions for entropy production and entropy extraction rates, we extend the existing theoretical frameworks by considering a force or temperature that varies exponentially, linearly, and quadratically.

arxiv-2511-22701.title: Low-Pass Filtering of Active Turbulent Flows to Liquid Substrates
arxiv-2511-22701.creator: Gianmarco Spera, Julia M. Yeomans, Sumesh P. Thampi
arxiv-2511-22701.description: Abstract To study the impact of active systems on their surroundings, we introduce a model that couples an active nematic fluid to an isotropic substrate fluid via friction. We numerically show that as the active layer develops turbulence, the substrate inherits the chaotic behaviour, exhibiting a novel form of turbulence driven by locally generated stochastic forcing from the active layer.

arxiv-2604-24526.title: Tests of scalar polarizations with multi-messenger events
arxiv-2604-24526.creator: Sk Md Adil Imam, Macarena Lagos

britannica-1911-erzgebirge.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-erzgebirge.description: Article 'Erzgebirge' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 9), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. direction from the Elbe to the Elstergebirge along the frontier between Saxony and Bohemia. Its length from E.N.E. is about 80 m., and its average breadth about 25 m.

pmc-10528813.title: Sonographic Detection of Fetal Cholelithiasis
pmc-10528813.creator: Nicolae Gică, Andra Radoi, Corina Gică, Anca Maria Panaitescu, Gheorghe Peltecu, Iulia Huluță
pmc-10528813.description: Fetal biliary lithiasis is a benign condition characterized by the presence of gallstones in the gallbladder of a developing fetus. It is typically detected incidentally during a routine obstetric echography. The incidence of this condition varies from 0.03% to 2.3%. In most cases, fetal cholelithiasis resolves spontaneously and has an excellent prognosis.

pmc-10637874.title: What is a “Distinctive Nutritional Requirement”? A Position Paper of the Healthcare Nutrition Council☆
pmc-10637874.creator: Katie Chmielecki, Berit Dockter, Wendy Johnson, Madeline Jurch, Pamela Pacht, Jena Rostorfer
pmc-10637874.description: The Healthcare Nutrition Council (HNC) represents manufacturers of enteral nutrition formulas and oral nutrition supplements, including those categorized as medical foods and parenteral nutrition. HNC member companies, Abbott’s Nutrition Division, Nestlé Health Science, and Nutricia North America, a subsidiary of Danone S.A., manufacture a majority of the medical foods consumed in the United States.

pmc-10719244.title: Ultrasound performance in pediatric deep soft-tissue tumor characterization
pmc-10719244.creator: Cong Li, Wenyi Chen, Ya Jin, Hong Xu, Hong Luo
pmc-10719244.description: This study investigated the performance of ultrasonography in diagnosing deep soft-tissue tumors and tumor-like lesions in children with histological results. Demographic information and ultrasound characteristics of benign and malignant masses were statistically analyzed. Three radiologists (Radiologists 1, 2, and 3) independently reviewed the ultrasonography studies while being blinded to the medical history and other imaging findings.

pmc-11352756.title: Frequency of Deleterious Germline Variants in HER2-Low Breast Cancer Patients Using a Hereditary Multipanel Gene Testing
pmc-11352756.creator: Janaina Pontes Batista Cassoli, Ítalo Fernandes, Leonardo Carvalho, Milena Fernandes, Ana Fernanda Centrone, Letícia Taniwaki, Rita de Cássia Lima, Uelson Donizeti Rocioli Junior, Igor Wanderley Reis Dias, Patrícia Taranto, Juliana Beal, Fernanda Teresa de Lima, Fernando Moura, Miguel Cendoroglo, Se
pmc-11352756.description: HER2-Low is defined as low levels of HER2 expression, based on a score of 1+ on immunohistochemical (IHC) assay or as an IHC score of 2+ and negative results on in situ hybridization (ISH or FISH). They are a heterogeneous population of breast cancers that vary in prognosis and sensitivity to systemic treatments.

pmc-11431703.title: Hyaluronic Acid in Nanopharmaceuticals: An Overview
pmc-11431703.creator: Sina Matalqah, Zainab Lafi, Sara Yousef Asha
pmc-11431703.description: Hyaluronic acid (HA) is a naturally occurring, long, unbranched polysaccharide that plays a critical role in maintaining skin structure and hydration. Its unique properties make it a valuable component in the field of nanopharmaceuticals. The combination of HA into nanopharmaceuticals enhances its ability to interact with various therapeutic agents, improving the delivery and efficacy of drugs.

pmc-11467902.title: Giant Thermosalient Effect in a Molecular Single Crystal: Dynamic Transformations and Mechanistic Insights
pmc-11467902.creator: Mohammad Afsar Uddin, Raúl Martín, Sergio Gámez-Valenzuela, Marcelo Echeverri, M. Carmen Ruiz Delgado, Enrique Gutiérrez Puebla, Angeles Monge, Berta Gómez-Lor
pmc-11467902.description: The exploration of mechanical motion in molecular crystals under external stimuli is of great interest because of its potential applications in diverse fields, such as electronics, actuation, or sensing. Understanding the underlying processes, including phase transitions and structural changes, is crucial for exploiting the dynamic nature of these crystals.

pmc-11492652.title: Systematisation of the causes that required revision hip replacement, methods of their solution, treatment results in Ukraine
pmc-11492652.creator: Vitalii Pidhaietskyi, Mykhailo Pidhaietskyi
pmc-11492652.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe objective of this study is to organise data on complications following total hip replacement (THA) over a span of 10 years, specifically focussing on cases that necessitated revision endoprosthetic surgeries. The objective is to create a recommendation for an All-Ukrainian registry of initial and repeated hip arthroplasty (HA) and standardise the terminology used to define “revision of total hip replacement surgery”.MethodsThe retrospective analysis examined 236 instances of revision hip arthroplasty (rTHA) performed at the Institute of Traumatology and Orthopaedics Centre between

pmc-11543781.title: The on-Site Monitoring and Specimen-Making of Ectoparasites on Rodents and Other Small Mammals
pmc-11543781.creator: Peng-Wu Yin, Xian-Guo Guo, Wen-Yu Song, Wen-Ge Dong, Yan Lv, Dao-Chao Jin
pmc-11543781.description: The ectoparasites of rodents and other small mammals usually involve five categories of arthropods—fleas, sucking lice, gamasid mites, chigger mites, and occasionally, ticks. These ectoparasites are medically important, serving as vectors for diseases such as plague, murine typhus, scrub typhus, forest encephalitis, Lyme disease, and other zoonoses.

pmc-1182327.title: Why Most Published Research Findings Are False
pmc-1182327.creator: Ioannidis JP.
pmc-1182327.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). There is increasing concern that most current published research findings are false. The probability that a research claim is true may depend on study power and bias, the number of other studies on the same question, and, importantly, the ratio of true to no relationships among t

pmc-12599059.title: Ethnobotanical study of wild edible plants in Karamara forest patches, Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-12599059.creator: Getu Alemayehu, Ashebir Awoke, Zewdie Kassa
pmc-12599059.description: BackgroundWild edible plants (WEPs) play a vital role in ensuring food security, enhancing nutrition, and preserving cultural heritage, particularly in dryland ecosystems. In Eastern Ethiopia, the Karamara forest patches host a rich diversity of WEPs; however, comprehensive ethnobotanical documentation remains scarce.

pmc-12631764.title: High Burden of Coinfections With Epidemic-Prone Pathogens Among Febrile Patients in Nigeria: A Multi-Pathogen Surveillance Study
pmc-12631764.creator: Cyril Erameh, Lauren P Courtney, Vivian Kwaghe, Jay Osi Samuels, Claire A Quiner, Jean H Kim, Osahogie Isaac Edeawe, Nankpah Godsave Vongdip, Adamu Zigwai Ephraim, Onyia Justus Ejike, Ikponmwosa Odia, Katherine Asman, Philippe Chebu, Jacqueline Agbukor, Oladimeji Damilare Matthew, Victoria Orok, Fem
pmc-12631764.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCharacterizing the etiology of acute febrile illness (AFI) remains a critical public health priority in malaria-endemic regions such as Nigeria, where constrained diagnostic capacity frequently contributes to misdiagnosis and delays in outbreak detection and response.

pmc-12693849.title: Nanotechnology Strategies in Plant Genetic Engineering: Intelligent Delivery and Precision Editing
pmc-12693849.creator: Chun-Mei Lai, Xiao-Shan Xiao, Li-Wei Liu, Xin-Da Lin, Dan-Lin Dou, Han-Yang Cai, Zhi-Feng Mei, Fan Yang, Yan Cheng, Yuan Qin
pmc-12693849.description: Plant genetic engineering is crucial for enhancing crop yield, quality, and resilience to both abiotic and biotic stresses, thereby promoting sustainable agriculture. Agrobacterium-mediated, biolistic bombardment, electroporation, and poly (ethylene glycol) (PEG)-mediated genetic transformation systems are widely applied in plant genetic engineering. However, these systems have limitations, including species dependency, destruction of plant tissues, low transformation efficiency, and high cost.

pmc-13009320.title: Microplastic mineralization rate in Fenton reactions depends on polymer type
pmc-13009320.creator: Katharina J Neubert, Nina Siebers, Nicolas Brüggemann
pmc-13009320.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite microplastics (MPs) being highly inert pollutants, Fenton‐type reactions—using hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and iron(II) ions (Fe2+)—may effectively initiate chain cleavage and induce mineralization. However, mineralization rates and mechanisms for different MP types at varying Fenton reagent concentrations remain unclear. This study examined the mineralization of four MPs— low‐density polyethylene (LDPE), polypropylene (PP), polystyrene (PS), and polyester (PES)—by measuring CO2 release across varying H2O2 concentrations. Mineralization rates depended on both polymer type and H2O2 concentration.

pmc-13097068.title: Stage-specific regulation of KSHV infection by HIF-1α
pmc-13097068.creator: See-Chi Lee, Minhchau To, Bernadett Papp, Steeve Boulant, Zsolt Toth
pmc-13097068.description: The impact of physiological stress conditions on Kaposi’s sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV) infection remains poorly understood. One such stressor, hypoxia, is regulated by the transcription factor HIF-1α. We recently reported that hypoxia, or HIF-1α expression alone, can promote lytic infection in cells that typically support latent infection under normoxia.

pmc-13133362.title: Measuring gross motor skills in African children using the PERF-FIT
pmc-13133362.creator: Bouwien Smits-Engelsman, Dané Coetzee, Rosemary Xorlanyo Doe-Asinyo, Oluwakemi Adebukola Ituen, Faical Farhat, Yabsra Melaku Dubale, Evi Verbecque
pmc-13133362.description: BackgroundAfrica is facing a rising prevalence of non-communicable diseases (NCDs), driven by shifts in lifestyle and dietary habits. Children with delays in motor coordination are less likely to participate in physical activity, active play, and sports, placing them at increased risk for obesity, reduced physical fitness, and cardiovascular diseases.

pmc-13318855.creator: Simone Frediani, Angelo Zarfati, Pietro Betalli, Marco Gambino, Pietro Impellizzeri, Francesco Morini, Sezione Chirurgia Pediatrica d’Urgenza SICP Study Group, Ivan Pietro Aloi

pmc-13647045.title: Fatty acid synthase promotes Hantaan virus infection through lipogenic regulation in the tree shrew model
pmc-13647045.creator: Yue-Chun Wu, Han-Song Qi, Feng-Yi Li, Jin-Xuan Yang, Ling Xu, Xiao-Qin Guo, Gui-Jun Chen, Ju-Min Zhou, Yong-Gang Yao, Xing-Lou Yang
pmc-13647045.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hantaan virus (HTNV) is the principal etiological agent of hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) in Asia. To date, however, progress in defining mechanisms of host-pathogen interaction has been limited by the absence of an appropriate animal model. In the present study, the tree shrew (Tupaia belangeri) was shown to be permissive to HTNV infection and to recapitulate key renal pathology and immunological features observed in patients with HFRS.

uslaw-usc-t35-s154.title: 35 U.S.C. § 154 — Contents and term of patent; provisional rights
uslaw-usc-t35-s154.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t35-s154.description: United States Code, Title 35 (Patents); Part II (Patentability Of Inventions And Grant Of Patents); Chapter 14 (Issue Of Patent). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— (1) Contents.— Every patent shall contain a short title of the invention and a grant to the patentee, his heirs or assigns, of the right to exclude others from making, using, offering for sale.
